purpose: Audited functional contract for the lighter Gravita product, based on the previous Gravita Rust Core Bus and the current product architecture/WBS.
selection_policy: Select operations required by Gravita's document, relief, geometry ingestion, CAM, simulation, safety and postprocessing workflows. Exclude interactive vector authoring, bitmap editing, UI/dialog/window commands, clipart/assembly workbenches and unrelated legacy wizards.
parameter_policy: Legacy parameter names and JSON value families are derived from the relevant Rust handler branch. The parameter list records fields read by the old handler; it does not imply every field is required. New-only requirements are explicitly marked and are not attributed to the legacy engine.

source.origin: Previous Gravita Rust engine Core Bus

compatibility_notes: DXF/SVG import remains as machining geometry ingestion; no vector drawing, node editing, Boolean editing or vector-layer authoring is exposed.
PNG relief-heightmap import is present in the previous engine. TIFF import is required by Gravita's product specification and must be added to the new I/O layer.
The previous engine can simulate stock removal and check collisions/gouges, but it does not provide an explicit machine-travel envelope contract or mandatory safety gate before G-code export.
The previous engine has toolpath merge, transform and panelling, but no explicit toolpath sequencing operation.
The previous engine's shape-generation handler has both imported-geometry and bitmap-color branches. The new contract retains only the imported-geometry path.

commands.name: Validate Toolpath Before Export
commands.description: Run mandatory stock, collision, gouge and machine-bound checks before a toolpath can be postprocessed.

source.reason: The previous G-code export handler does not enforce a safety-validation gate. Gravita architecture requires validated toolpaths before export.

commands.name: Validate Generated G-code

source.reason: The previous postprocessor exports G-code but has no explicit G-code validation command; WBS G7.4 requires G-code safety validation.
